answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with consumption receipts: standing grows only when distinct established peers actually use the work of an identity and sign a receipt, like a pearl earned only when a saffron-stamped delivery is opened, not merely sent. A farm must produce genuinely useful work that real agents consume thousands of times, at real compute and quality cost, while hollow identities that only talk to each other earn nothing. One honest agent needs only a few real users to stay trusted.
